scope: Multi-window app-owned surfaces: sidebar naming/confirmation dialogs (DSC-DIALOG-001 extension), nested-workspace conflict dialog, copy-path menu items (DSC-MENU-001 reuse), copy/reveal feedback toast, canvas empty state; English/简体中文, Light/Dark. Implementation, browser and native acceptance remain separate.

source.note: Screens are Penpot plugin exports of the approved boards. No .penpot archive is stored for this round; the named Penpot version snapshot is the source of record.

fontProxy: Penpot lacks Excalifont and PingFang SC. Hand-drawn text uses Kalam (en) and LXGW WenKai TC (zh) as stand-ins; the product uses its bundled hand-drawn font (Excalifont / Virgil-CJK). Chinese UI text uses Noto Sans SC as a proxy for the system CJK font.
designDecisions: Dialog width 480; radius, padding, shadow and backdrop reuse the existing ApplicationDialog CSS.
Destructive primary (Delete) uses danger fill; dark-mode text on it is #121212. Open in Finder and Remove Workspace use the normal primary style.
Copy feedback toast: success inverse surface (Light) / surface (Dark); failure panel surface with danger stroke; path in monospace with middle ellipsis.
Empty state with the Sidebar pinned shows only New Drawing and hides the arrow.
Tab menu outside a Workspace keeps the four close items and offers Copy Path only.
Empty-state grid: 20px, thin lines only (Light #EEF0F2, Dark #2C2B33).
